lines.en: Oink oink, two steps and then we see.
Soft mud. My hooves like it.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但一直在走。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I keep going.

lines.zh: 前面有草，我先去啃一口。
lines.en: Grass ahead. Let me grab a bite.

lines.zh: 鼻子贴着地，闻着回家的路。
lines.en: Nose to the ground, sniffing the way home.
Do not rush me; this is how pigs walk.
A flick of the tail and I turn.
My belly sways because I ate well.
The grass on this ridge is tender. I come often.

lines.zh: 蹄印一路，跟着就能找到我。
lines.en: Follow the hoofprints and you will find me.
Slow down. My legs are short.
Oink. What a long walk today.

lines.zh: 闻到胡萝卜味了，我改道。
lines.en: I smell carrots. Changing direction.
A wobble per step, and steady as anything.

lines.zh: 我顺着栅栏走，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I walk the fence line, round and round.

lines.zh: 脚下一滑，我摔进了草里。
lines.en: My hoof slipped and I fell into the grass.
Lie down a while. The grass is soft.
I am thinking about my next meal.
Sun on my back. Makes me sleepy.
That mouthful of mud tasted fine.
Anyone there? No? Back to lying down.
My snout itches. I will rub the fence.

lines.zh: 今天的草长得比昨天高。
lines.en: The grass grew taller than yesterday.
I do not think. Thinking is tiring.
One grunt will serve as my answer.
My ears twitched. Just wind.
I claim this mud puddle.
Well fed, and the world goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我打了个滚，背上全是土。
lines.en: I rolled over; my back is all dirt.
Counted my friends. All still asleep.

lines.zh: 听见有人喊，我抬头看一眼。
lines.en: I hear a call and lift my head once.
This stone is just right for scratching my back.

lines.zh: 你手里拿的是胡萝卜吗？
lines.en: Is that a carrot in your hand?
Standing this close — are you feeding me?
Looking up at you makes my neck ache.

lines.zh: 你笑起来，像拿着土豆的人。
lines.en: You smile like a man holding a potato.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是等你掏东西。
lines.en: I stare at you, waiting for you to pull something out.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾了泥，跟我一样。
lines.en: Your boots are muddy, same as me.

lines.zh: 别摸鼻子，那儿刚拱过土。
lines.en: Not the snout; it has just been in the dirt.
You smell faintly of cooked pork.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但认得你的手。
lines.en: I do not know you, but I know your hands.
What are you looking at? I have no grass on my face.
You crouch down, and over I come.
Small eyes, but I see you clearly.
Ow — what did you hit me for?
I am running. I am running now.
Ow ow ow, stop chasing me.
I did nothing to you.
After that, I am hiding in the pen.
Thick hide is no match for a sword.

lines.zh: 别砍了，我身上没几斤肉。
lines.en: Stop swinging; there is hardly any meat on me.
Oink — my voice cracked.
I am backing off. Truly backing off.

lines.zh: 你这一下真重，我记住了。
lines.en: That swing was heavy. I will remember it.
Carrot! Give it here, give it here.
A potato will do. I am not picky.
Beetroot? I will accept it, grudgingly.

lines.zh: 你把胡萝卜举高，我就跟着走。
lines.en: Hold the carrot high and I will follow.

lines.zh: 那根杆子上绑的，是我的最爱。
lines.en: That thing tied to a stick is my favorite.
Do not swing it so fast; I cannot keep up.
I smell it — sweet and crisp.

lines.zh: 为了一口吃的，我什么都肯。
lines.en: For one bite, I would agree to anything.
Lower your hand; I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 这个味道，能让我跑起来。
lines.en: That smell could make me run.
I am drooling. Do not laugh.
One bite, and you may ride me.
That is not food? Then I am off.
My nose arrives first, my mouth right after.
Put the bucket down and I will come.

lines.zh: 我已经跟着你走了半里地。
lines.en: I have followed you half a mile already.
Hey, you bumped my belly.
I am this round and you will not step aside?
My hooves slipped. Nearly fell.
Do not crowd; the pen is only so big.

lines.zh: 你踩进我刚拱松的土里。
lines.en: You stepped into the soil I just rooted up.
One bump and all my fat jiggles.
Oink. You are blocking the trough.
I step back; you step back too.
This close — do you mean to hug me?
Bump and part. No hard feelings.
Two pigs together, and that is a home.
You smell of grass. I like that.
Stop nosing me. Slow down.

lines.zh: 等小猪出生，圈里就热闹了。
lines.en: When the piglets come, the pen will be lively.
Let us root up this patch together.
You do not steal my food. You will do.

lines.zh: 尾巴碰尾巴，算是说好了。
lines.en: Tail against tail — that settles it.

lines.zh: 我这辈子没别的，就图个伴。
lines.en: I want nothing in life but company.
Step away; the little ones need sleep.
Come close slowly. Do not startle me.
Food on the ground? I will take it.
I cannot carry things; I only root.

lines.zh: 掉下来的胡萝卜归我了。
lines.en: The dropped carrot is mine.

lines.zh: 这土里埋的东西，我能闻出来。
lines.en: I can smell what is buried in this dirt.
Mouth opens; in it goes.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满了，先嚼会儿。
lines.en: My mouth is full. Let me chew.
Not that grass — too old.
Whatever I find, half is yours.

lines.zh: 鼻子拱一拱，什么都能翻出来。
lines.en: A nudge of the snout turns up anything.

lines.zh: 谁掉的？反正现在是我的。
lines.en: Whose was it? Mine now.

lines.zh: 那边有东西动了，过去看看。
lines.en: Something moved over there. Let me look.
It is food. I recognized it.
A sound. I lift my head first.
That one is holding a carrot.
Keep an eye on it. Do not let it go.
I smell something sweet. Direction set.

lines.zh: 是谁踩了草丛？我听见了。
lines.en: Who stepped in the bushes? I heard it.
It reached the trough before me. Not allowed.
The target holds still. So do I.

lines.zh: 眼睛盯住了，鼻子也跟上了。
lines.en: Eyes fixed, nose following.
I have my eye on that patch — tenderest grass.
It takes a step; I take one back.
Do not take it. I saw it first.
Approaching slowly so I do not spook it.
Head down, pretending not to watch.
The moment it turns, I charge.

lines.zh: 我低着头，用鼻子对准它。
lines.en: Head low, I aim my snout at it.
Circling to find the shortest path.
My nose says it is just ahead.
I have stared so long I am nearly asleep.
That nudge was not a fight.
Do not steal my food, or I headbutt you.

lines.zh: 我冲过来，只是想要那根萝卜。
lines.en: I charge because I want that carrot.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬不动你，我试过了。
lines.en: My teeth cannot bite through you. I tried.
Hooves scraping dirt. That is your warning.
Step back and I will not charge.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼吧？我就这力气。
lines.en: That did not hurt, did it? This is all the strength I have.
I stagger more than you do after a hit.
Not the stick. That one frightens me.
One snort, and then I run off.

lines.zh: 我在草地上出生，光够亮。
lines.en: I was born on grass, in bright light.
First thing I saw, I looked for food.

lines.zh: 这圈里味道熟悉，我留下。
lines.en: This pen smells familiar. I will stay.
Grass two blocks high — just right.
Sun is out. Time for a roll.

lines.zh: 一窝里我最小，吃得最多。
lines.en: Smallest of the litter, biggest appetite.
Just standing up; my legs are still soft.
Someone is here. I will oink twice.
Plenty of grass here. I am moving in.
A new day begins with rooting in the dirt.
Hot! My back bristles are singed.
I landed on my belly.
Too deep; my hooves cannot find bottom.
The blast packed my snout full of dirt.
The arrow is in deep; I cannot pull it.
A numbness runs over me; my bristles stand up.
My belly is empty. Off to find grass.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，焦味真冲。
lines.en: Lightning hit my back; the burnt smell is sharp.
Falling, and I cannot see a thing.
